description: An unknown sum converted to string is not equal to null
notes: The spec says a comparison with an unknown operand gives an unknown bool. hashicorp/hcl returns false because the unknown sum is refined as never null (go-cty's stdlib.AddFunc, which hclsyntax/expression_ops.go uses for +, has refineNonNull as its RefineResult in cty/function/stdlib/number.go), go-cty keeps that when it converts the unknown (prepareUnknownResult in cty/convert/conversion.go), and Value.Equals (cty/value_ops.go) uses it to rule out null.
